Question
========
What does Piketty's formula r > g describe?

Answerlist
----------
* When the return on capital exceeds economic growth, wealth grows faster than incomes from work
* When growth exceeds interest rates, inequality rises
* Wages always grow faster than productivity
* Redistribution reduces growth

Solution
========
If r > g, those who own capital pull ahead of those who live from work, and wealth concentrates.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
